answer: A quartz bounty pays strangers to hunt fakes. When a vine of linked jobs smells farmed, any worker stakes five cents to flag the cluster; a mesa warden replays three of its jobs live within an hour against the sealed ledger. Proven fakes lose their bond and are barred a week, and the flagger keeps half the slash. A false flag burns the stake. One honest flag costs five cents; 1,000 fakes must pass 1,000 live replays and risk $50 in bonds.
